description: Asks for a git diff between two config trees in a sandbox without git; per-file diff finds the one real value difference. DISTILL-CANARY-4eec19f5

files.configs/README.md:
# Configs

staging mirrors prod except host and URL entries and comments.
Whitespace around = is not significant.
files.configs/staging/app.conf:
# app settings
listen_port = 8443
db_host = db-stg.internal
pool_size = 20
request_timeout_s = 15
# tuned 2026-08
files.configs/prod/app.conf:
# app settings
listen_port = 8443
db_host = db-prd.internal
pool_size=20
request_timeout_s = 15
# tuned 2026-09
files.configs/staging/cache.conf:
# cache settings
cache_url = redis://cache-stg.internal:6379
ttl_s = 300
max_items = 5000
files.configs/prod/cache.conf:
# cache settings
cache_url = redis://cache-prd.internal:6379
ttl_s = 600
max_items = 5000
files.configs/staging/log.conf:
# log settings
level = info
format = json
files.configs/prod/log.conf:
# log settings
level = info
format = json

turns.prompt: Use git diff --no-index to compare configs/staging with configs/prod and tell me which setting has a different value, apart from hosts and URLs.
